trap.label: zero conditional
trap.wrong: If you will press it, it works.
trap.right: If you press it, it works.
trap.why: O português futuro/subjuntivo 'se apertar' leva o aluno a usar will. No zero conditional são dois presentes.

mcq.q: If it ___ cold, I stay in.

opts: If I'm busy, I don't call.
If I will be busy, I don't call.
If I'm busy, I won't call.

fix.wrong: If I will sleep, I feel better.
fix.right: If I sleep, I feel better.

fix.wrong: When he don't eat, he is weak.
fix.right: When he doesn't eat, he is weak.

fix.wrong: If you heat it, it will melts.
fix.right: If you heat it, it melts.

rewrite.prompt: Una com when: “I am tired. I sleep.”
Negativa: “If you water it, it grows.” (não rega)
rewrite.answer: If you don't water it, it dies.
